Lemma
[Normal derivative estimate on a hypersurface] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0317 ↗ thm:chow-iii-evolving-heat-kernel-expansion 1. ch24:24.35\group Boundary Layer Potentials

Let $\mathcal N^{n-1}\subset \mathcal M$ be a compact smooth hypersurface. For $x,y\in \mathcal N$, $0\le \sigma < au \le T$, and a unit normal $ u _{y,\sigma }$, \[ \left|\partial _{ u _{y,\sigma }}H(x, au ;y,\sigma ) ight| \le C( au -\sigma )^{-n/2} \left( rac{d_ au ^2(x,y)}{ au -\sigma }+C ight) e^{-d_ au ^2(x,y)/(5( au -\sigma ))}. \] It is consequently bounded by $C( au -\sigma )^{-n/2}e^{-d_ au ^2/(6( au -\sigma ))}$.
